phishing.label: Phishing
phishing.action: Do not click links or open attachments. Go to the sender's official website or app by typing the address yourself.

bank_kyc.label: Bank/KYC Scam
bank_kyc.action: Banks do not ask you to update KYC through links in SMS. Open your bank's official app or visit a branch to check.

upi_payment.label: UPI/Payment Scam
upi_payment.action: Never approve a collect request or scan a QR code to RECEIVE money. Receiving money never needs your PIN.

job_internship.label: Job/Internship Scam
job_internship.action: Genuine employers do not charge fees to hire you. Verify the company on its official careers page before replying.

investment.label: Investment Scam
investment.action: Guaranteed high returns are a red flag. Check that the platform is registered with SEBI before sending money.

prize_lottery.label: Prize/Lottery Scam
prize_lottery.action: You cannot win a contest you did not enter. Do not pay any claim fee or share details.

support_impersonation.label: Customer-Support Impersonation
support_impersonation.action: Do not install remote-access apps or call numbers from the message. Find the support number on the official website.

govt_impersonation.label: Government/Service Impersonation
govt_impersonation.action: Government bodies do not demand payment or personal data over SMS or calls. Verify on the official .gov.in site.

account_verification.label: Account Verification Scam
account_verification.action: Do not verify through the link. Log in by typing the official address in your browser and check notifications there.

credential_theft.label: Credential Theft
credential_theft.action: Never share passwords, OTPs or PINs. If you already did, change your password and contact the provider immediately.

legitimate.label: Legitimate Communication
legitimate.action: No strong scam indicators found. Stay cautious and verify through official channels if anything feels unusual.

unknown.label: Unknown/Uncertain
unknown.action: Uncertain result. Verify the sender through an official channel before acting.
